note: 16 Nov, the owner: "how do we set up tests to make sure bob can manage an email inbox, sort, recommend replying to lists, from a human or from an automailer"; "some of my inboxes ... have tens of thousands of emails"; "could bob do bulk delete? or bulk archive?". The 30 inbox jobs (mail-jobs.mjs: 15 kinds, each on a Gmail and an Outlook inbox; 300-message graded inboxes and 20,000 / 50,000-message big ones) on made-up mailboxes (mail-world.mjs: .example addresses only, nothing can be sent, a draft is the most). Bob's own read_email and manage_email, today's tools, before any catalog. All four efforts at once (Effort on one brain: Minimus, Medius, Magnus, Maximus). No web search, no Tavily. Scored by code (mail-score.mjs), then every run read by Opus 5.5 from the blind digests. Clean runs become lessons only after that read. do-jobs runs the harness self-test (10 checks, with the inbox one) before any job. Brain: stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (tool shape 4), no add-on. L40S, 12 slots. Caps 2 h / $3.
